# library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(patchwork)
```

# paths

```{r}
cluster_stats_paths <- list.files(
  path =  "live/data/cluster_stats", 
  pattern = "summary_cluster_stats.tsv", 
  recursive = TRUE, 
  full.names = TRUE
)

sample_sheet_path <- "live/data/sample_sheet/sample_sheet.tsv" 
```

# read files

```{r, message=FALSE}
cluster_stats <- lapply(cluster_stats_paths, FUN = function(path){
  # extract timestamt "20260202_1735"
  timestamp <- str_extract(path, "\\d{8}_\\d{4}")
  
  read_tsv(path) %>%
    mutate(
      timestamp = timestamp
    )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

sample_sheet <- read_tsv(sample_sheet_path)
```

# tables

## paste timestamp to date time

```{r}
starttime <- as.POSIXct(min(cluster_stats$timestamp), format = "%Y%m%d_%H%M", tz = "UTC")
endttimte <- as.POSIXct(max(cluster_stats$timestamp), format = "%Y%m%d_%H%M", tz = "UTC")
 
cluster_stats_parsed <-
  cluster_stats %>%
  rename(
    barcode = sample
  ) %>% 
  inner_join(sample_sheet) %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    task_index_chtronological = row_number(),
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%d_%H%M", tz = "UTC"),
    runtime_hours = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, starttime, units = "hours")), 
    runtime_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, starttime, units = "mins")), 
    # name sample using group index
  )

write_tsv(cluster_stats, "live/data/cluster_stats/combined_cluster_stats.tsv")
```

## summary cluster stats at the end of sequencing

```{r}
cluster_stats_summary <-
  cluster_stats_parsed %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    sample,
    n_cluster,
    timestamp,
    runtime_hours
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample)

cluster_stats_summary_all <- 
  cluster_stats_summary %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_clusters = mean(n_cluster),
    median_clusters = median(n_cluster),
    sd_clusters = sd(n_cluster),
    min_clusters = min(n_cluster),
    max_clusters = max(n_cluster),
    total_clusters = sum(n_cluster),
    total_runtime_hours = max(runtime_hours),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### create table

```{r}
cluster_stats_table <-
cluster_stats_parsed %>% 
  select(
    # task_index_chtronological,
    # timestamp,
    runtime_hours,
    sample,
    n_cluster
  ) %>%
  # round runtime to 1 digit
  mutate(runtime_hours = round(runtime_hours, 2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = n_cluster
  )
```

#### backup table

```{r}
cluster_stats_parsed %>% 
  select(
    sample,
    # timestamp,
    runtime_hours,
    n_cluster
  ) %>%
  # round runtime to 1 digit
  mutate(runtime_hours = round(runtime_hours, 2)) %>%
  group_by(n_cluster) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
  arrange(sample, runtime_hours)

```

```{r}
# Count sample columns (everything except the runtime column)
n_sample_cols <- ncol(cluster_stats_table) - 1

# Build flextable and add grouped header
ft_cluster_stats <- cluster_stats_table %>% 
  rename(`Runtime [h]` = runtime_hours) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Number of cluster per sample [n]"),
    colwidths = c(1, n_sample_cols),
  ) %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 5, part = "all") %>% 
  theme_zebra() %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  border_outer(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%  
  border_inner_v(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5))%>%
  border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5))

# Export to Word
doc_cluster_stats <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Cluster Statistics over Time", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_cluster_stats) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal")  # optional spacer 

print(doc_cluster_stats, target = "live/out/Cluster_Stats_over_time.docx")

```

#### save for main figure

```{r}
cluster_stats_parsed %>% 
  write_tsv("main_figure/data/full_run_cluster_stats_parsed.tsv")
```

# plot

## number of cluster per sample over time

```{r}
p.clusters_over_time <-
  cluster_stats_parsed %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = runtime_hours, y = n_cluster, color = sample, group = sample)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
  labs(
    # title = "Number of clusters per sample over time",
    x = "Runtime [h]",
    y = "Clusters [n]",
    color = "Sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18), 
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p.clusters_over_time

ggsave( 
  plot = p.clusters_over_time, 
  filename = "clusters_over_time.jpg", 
  path = "live/out", 
  width = 12, 
  height = 9, 
  dpi = 300
)
```
